validation_rules: binary-artifact-inventory.json must include artifact path, hash, file type, architecture or an explicit gap
tool-evidence-manifest.json must list each tool output path and whether it succeeded, failed, or was skipped
candidate-leads.json must classify leads as attack, defense, dependency, similarity, symbol, string, debug, or follow-up evidence
candidate leads must cite evidence files and remain candidate or follow_on_required unless independently verified
binary-intelligence-summary.md must state scope, flags enabled, unsupported formats, and coverage limitations
status.json must include every required status field
runtime behavior, exploitability, and High/Critical findings are forbidden without downstream independent verification
